claim_one_line: CELL 1: J^{2T} IS THE CHARGE FIELD -- the fixed Jordan subalgebra of the principal 2T in F4 = Aut(J) is K = Q[x]/(x^3-12x-5), FIELD discriminant exactly 6237 = 3^4*7*11, totally real, Galois S3, verified three independent ways (root test; disc f = 6237*61931520^2 with the square factored out and no extension machinery; the reduced model L^3-273L+1372 with disc 6237*70^2). Against the two-sided sealed criterion: it is a cubic FIELD so there are no primitive idempotents over Q and NO RATIONAL rank-1 VEV, but it is TOTALLY REAL so over R it splits into three, and cell 1 exhibits all three explicitly -- they sum to the identity exactly, a complete orthogonal frame, and their coordinates are Galois-conjugate with the same square-free disc part 77. Every E6/F4 invariant of a single idempotent (tr 1, sigma_2 -1/3, det 0) is IDENTICAL across the three, and all symmetric functions are rational, so THE CHOICE OF REAL EMBEDDING IS INVISIBLE TO EVERYTHING GALOIS-INVARIANT -- a gauge, not a parameter, costing zero invariant information. Consequence for any future dynamical import: it can only matter if it is NOT Galois-equivariant. CELL 2 (NEGATIVE, the sharpest result here): THE OBJECT'S OWN IDEMPOTENT PAIR DOES NOT GIVE SU(5). The standard E6 -> SU(5) route needs two rank-1 elements in GENERAL POSITION; the object's two are ORTHOGONAL, being members of a frame. Annihilator dimensions in e6, computed mod p at three primes (1093, 1097, 1151, identical): one idempotent 61 = so(10)+16 (THE GATE, forced by rank-1 as 78-17); TWO idempotents 44 = so(8)+16, reductive part so(8) of rank 4; all three 28 = so(8), the pointwise frame stabiliser, which pins the so(8) independently. 24 and 25 are excluded by dimension, so su(5) and su(5)+u(1) are both out. And so(8) is ACHIRAL -- -1 is in W(D4), so every so(8) representation is self-dual and the 27 restricts real. THIS IS THE FOURTH INDEPENDENT ARRIVAL AT 'right rank, no chirality' after B953's theta-split, B959's tau-fold, and cell 1's degree-0 direction landing on F4. The object reaches rank 4 by every route it has and kills the 27's complexity every time. L138 therefore does NOT fire even over R, and the obstruction is not the reality of the points but their RELATIVE POSITION: orthogonality is the degenerate configuration, and the object hands its rank-1 elements over already orthogonal because they are the primitive idempotents of a field.
